question:
A factory makes gadgets and widgets. Each gadget takes 3 hours assembly, 2 hours testing; each widget 2 hours assembly, 4 hours testing. Available: 18 hours assembly, 24 hours testing per day. It is required to produce at least 2 gadgets and at least 3 widgets daily. The profit on one gadget is ₹60 and one widget is ₹80.

(a) Formulate the LPP.

(b) Find the vertices of the feasible region.

(c) Compute the maximum profit and corresponding production numbers.

options.A:
(a) Maximize $Z=60x+80y$, subject to $3x+2y\leq18$, $2x+4y\leq24$, $x\geq2$, $y\geq3$
(b) Vertices: $(2,3)$, $(2,5)$, $(4,3)$
(c) Produce 4 gadgets and 3 widgets; maximum profit ₹480.
options.B:
(a) Maximize $Z=60x+80y$, subject to $3x+2y\leq18$, $2x+4y\leq24$, $x\geq2$, $y\geq3$
(b) Vertices: $(2,3)$, $(2,6)$, $(4,3)$
(c) Produce 2 gadgets and 6 widgets; maximum profit ₹600.
options.C:
(a) Maximize $Z=60x+80y$, subject to $3x+2y\leq18$, $2x+4y\leq24$, $x\geq2$, $y\geq3$
(b) Vertices: $(2,3)$, $(2,5)$, $(4,3)$
(c) Produce 2 gadgets and 3 widgets; maximum profit ₹360.
options.D:
(a) Maximize $Z=60x+80y$, subject to $3x+2y\leq18$, $2x+4y\leq24$, $x\geq2$, $y\geq3$
(b) Vertices: $(2,3)$, $(2,5)$, $(4,3)$
(c) Produce 2 gadgets and 5 widgets; maximum profit ₹520.
